description:
SUBMIT drafts into the human's approval queue (scope order_submit_request; OAuth grant). Queues only — unless auto_approved:true (owner's small-order rule): order created, pay next.
- draft_id → request_id + approval_url; or draft_ids (one per seller) → all or none, ONE approvals page. The human approves on webaz.xyz (usually a tap). Pending requests and unpaid agent orders are capped (ORDER_REQUEST_LIMIT).
- Approval (server-side) re-validates price/stock/region/rail (drift hard-fails → re-quote), then creates the REAL order exactly as approved. No money moves then; paying needs the human (Passkey or wallet).
- Idempotent: a retry returns the SAME request (duplicate_reason); the explicit 再买一份 action (new_purchase_intent) creates an independent purchase.

idempotency_key.description: Optional [A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}: click+retries share it → same result; same key + different payload → IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT (no execute).

new_purchase_intent.description: true only from the explicit 再买一份 card action → an independent purchase; not inferred from conversation.

operation_attempt_id.description: Optional trace id (diagnostics only, never a dedup key).

purchase_intent_instance.description: Optional nonce for one independent purchase (with new_purchase_intent); server mints one if omitted.

name: webaz_submit_order_request

outputSchema.description: webaz.order_approval.model.v2 — approval submit projection: pending human approval, or auto_approved + executed (owner's small-order rule); duplicate-purchase protection surfaces an explicit warning

duplicate_warning.description: legacy: existing request REUSED, no second approval/order

error.description: present ONLY on failure (with error_code + structured recovery fields)

on_approval.description: approval creates the single order; payment follows the disclosed rail (direct_p2p: no principal held)

status.description: v2 status {code,label,label_en}; code canonical (never from label)
